candidate.answerReason: Equal, bisected diagonals give \(OA=OB=4\). The isosceles triangle \(AOB\) has a \(60^\circ\) vertex angle, so it is equilateral and \(AB=4\).

methods.label: Recognize an equilateral triangle
methods.explanation: The diagonals are equal in length and bisect each other, so \(OA=OB=4\). Since \(\angle AOB=60^\circ\), \(\triangle AOB\) is equilateral, and \(AB=4\).
methods.levelReason: Rectangle diagonal properties and the equilateral-triangle criterion are within Grade 8 geometry.
